name: courier-file-icons
description: Courier's own icons for courier.config.ts, courier.mocks.ts and the .courier folder in Material Icon Theme and vscode-icons, the folder drawn in each theme's own style. In as the editor starts, they follow you into the other theme, onto your other machines, into remote windows and through updates, and come out with one click.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, Courier File Icons takes the folder vscode-icons reads custom icons from out of your own settings only, never out of the workspace's, so the workspace cannot choose where Courier's icons are written.

commands.title: Show Courier's Icons in the File Icon Theme
Remove Courier's Icons from the File Icon Theme

courier.fileIcons.automatic.markdownDescription: Put Courier's own icons for `courier.config.ts`, `courier.mocks.ts` and `.courier` into the icon theme in use by themselves when it is Material Icon Theme or vscode-icons: as the editor starts, and into each such theme you pick. Turns off once you take the icons out — with **Take Them Out** on the message that they went in, with **Courier: Remove Courier's Icons from the File Icon Theme**, or out of your settings by hand — and on again with **Courier: Show Courier's Icons in the File Icon Theme**. Read from your user settings only, never a workspace's.
